title: Zugel Dog Drawing
content: Even if you let a sleeping dog lie, you’re lucky if you get 15 minutes on one pose before it shifts to another.That makes Heinrich von Zugel’s pencil study is especially impressive. Note the planar breakdown of form in the shoulder, which almost looks like a cube. His form analysis is based on a deep knowledge of anatomy, as he was a professor of animal painting at the academy in Munich.------Teachers: You might still be able to sign up for the educator's workshop that I'll be giving this Saturday at theWoodson Art Museumin Wausau, Wisconsin from 10-11:30 AM. The event is part of the Dinotopia exhibition, which will be going on through April 7.
